difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a smooth morphism, the slice cut out by a function that is a nonzerodivisor on every fibre is again smooth over the base. The proof reduces to the ring-theoretic statement, where smoothness of the slice is deduced from smoothness of the ambient map plus the regularity of the slicing element, using the characterisation of smoothness by the differential module and the effect of the slice on differentials. Tracking the differential module through the quotient is what the argument turns on. Retained author proof at lines 10611-10658.
